rationale: Addresses cluster [validate_failed::workflow-section] (t03-multi-stage). The section is empty, so the agent loaded the skill but never ran the extract subcommand — it wrote data.json manually then jumped straight to validate. A minimal step-by-step workflow that mandates extract-before-validate will fix the routing confusion.
expected_effect: The agent will route to `extract` first instead of entering a wrong-subcommand loop or writing data.json directly, ensuring data.json is populated by the pipeline before validation.
regression_risk: If t01-id-based relied on the workflow section being empty to short-circuit to validate, adding instructions could change that path. However, since extract-then-validate is the correct general flow, the risk is low.
